summaries.name: Atlanta
summaries.summary: Destination of a round-trip flight from Boston that the user took on 2023/01/15, earning 10,000 Delta SkyMiles.

summaries.name: Amex Membership Rewards
summaries.summary: A transferable points program, similar to Chase Ultimate Rewards, that can be transferred to multiple airline loyalty programs.

summaries.name: Amex Platinum
summaries.summary: Offers 5X points on airline flights booked directly with airlines or through Amex Travel, and a $200 airline fee credit.

summaries.name: Citi Premier
summaries.summary: Earns points on travel purchases at a 3X points rate, with points transferable to multiple airline partners.

summaries.name: Capital One Venture
summaries.summary: A rewards program earning 2X miles on all purchases, redeemable for travel purchases with no blackout dates or restrictions.

summaries.name: Hilton Honors
summaries.summary: A hotel loyalty program covering a wide range of properties with a flexible points redemption system.
